# MapleHD
> MapleHD is a Canadian-focused IPTV service: 25,000+ live channels, 120,000+ movies and series on demand, 4K, EPG and 7-day catch-up on supported channels, from $9/month with a free trial and support by WhatsApp and email.
> Target market: Canada (English en-CA and French fr-CA).

## Main pages
- Pricing: https://maplehd.ca/pricing
- Free trial: https://maplehd.ca/free-trial

- Best IPTV in Canada: https://maplehd.ca/best-iptv-canada
- Channel list: https://maplehd.ca/channels-list
- Blog: https://maplehd.ca/blog

## Facts
- Works with standard IPTV players via Xtream Codes or M3U logins.
- Plans: 1 month $9, 3 months $29, 6 months $39, 12 months $49 (1 device); 1 to 10 simultaneous connections available.
- MapleHD is independent and is not affiliated with third-party player apps, box makers or other IPTV brands named on its comparison pages.
